settings.title: Tune your environment
settings.subtitle: Everything here is stored locally and takes effect immediately.
settings.profileDesc: Shown in the sidebar. Just for you — there's no multi-user sharing here.
settings.autosaveDesc: Automatically save changes as you type
settings.dataDesc: Everything lives in your browser's local storage. Export a backup, or import one to restore.
settings.aiDesc: PROMETHEUS is architected to support these without a redesign. They'll activate once an API key is connected.
settings.languageDesc: Switch the interface language. Your own notes, papers, and entries are never translated.
settings.importError: That file couldn't be read as a valid export.
settings.aiResearchAssistantDesc: Ask questions across your entire knowledge base.
settings.aiSummarizationDesc: Auto-generate summaries and key insights for new papers.
settings.aiIdeaGenerationDesc: Surface novel research directions from your reading.
settings.aiLabRecommendationDesc: Match your interests to labs worth reaching out to.
settings.aiScholarshipRecommendationDesc: Surface funding opportunities that fit your profile.
settings.aiSopReviewDesc: Get structured feedback on your statement of purpose.
settings.aiKnowledgeSearchDesc: Semantic search across papers, projects, and notes.
settings.aiConnectionDesc: Connect any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — OpenAI itself, a university or enterprise gateway, OpenRouter, a self-hosted model — to activate Paper Summarization below. Your key is sent straight to that endpoint on each request and never leaves your browser otherwise — not logged, not stored on any server.

research.title: Send the agent out to find what you haven't found yet
research.subtitle: A search planner that fans a research goal out across open scholarly APIs, then hands the results back for you to triage.
research.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Machine learning surrogates for gyrokinetic plasma turbulence
research.noResultsYet: Run a search to retrieve papers from arXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, and Crossref.
research.aiGatedDesc: Summarization, contradiction detection, gap analysis, and idea generation activate once an API key is connected in Settings.
research.excludedDesc: Google Scholar has no public API and disallows automated queries; publisher sites like Nature are paywalled. Both stay manual — add findings from them straight into Reading or Labs.
research.connectToSummarize: Connect an API key in Settings to summarize papers.
research.gapAiGatedDesc: Connect an API key in Settings to run gap analysis.
research.gapEmptyDesc: Enter a topic to see current state, open problems, top labs, most-cited papers, a reading order, and potential thesis ideas — grounded in real papers from arXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, and Crossref.
